#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate EV Charging Network Performance & Grid Optimization Report."""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df = pd.read_csv("/app/benchmark/data.csv")

# ── Basic cleaning ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df["timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(df["timestamp"], format="mixed", dayfirst=False)
df["waiting_time"] = pd.to_numeric(df["waiting_time"], errors="coerce")
df["energy_consumed_kWh"] = pd.to_numeric(df["energy_consumed_kWh"], errors="coerce")
df["station_load"] = pd.to_numeric(df["station_load"], errors="coerce")
df["renewable_energy_ratio"] = pd.to_numeric(df["renewable_energy_ratio"], errors="coerce")
df["optimization_reward"] = pd.to_numeric(df["optimization_reward"], errors="coerce")
df["electricity_price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["electricity_price"], errors="coerce")
df["charging_duration"] = pd.to_numeric(df["charging_duration"], errors="coerce")
df["charging_power_kW"] = pd.to_numeric(df["charging_power_kW"], errors="coerce")
df["queue_length"] = pd.to_numeric(df["queue_length"], errors="coerce")
df["battery_capacity_kWh"] = pd.to_numeric(df["battery_capacity_kWh"], errors="coerce")
df["initial_soc"] = pd.to_numeric(df["initial_soc"], errors="coerce")
df["final_soc"] = pd.to_numeric(df["final_soc"], errors="coerce")
df["charging_demand"] = pd.to_numeric(df["charging_demand"], errors="coerce")

total_sessions = len(df)

# ── KPIs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
avg_waiting_time = round(df["waiting_time"].mean(), 1)
avg_energy_per_session = round(df["energy_consumed_kWh"].mean(), 1)
mean_station_load = round(df["station_load"].mean(), 1)
mean_renewable_ratio = round(df["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean() * 100, 1)
mean_opt_reward = round(df["optimization_reward"].mean(), 2)

# ── Section 1: Station Utilization & Demand ──────────────────────────────────
loc_demand = df.groupby("location_type").agg(
    sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"),
    avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"),
    avg_energy=("energy_consumed_kWh", "mean"),
    avg_load=("station_load", "mean"),
    avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"),
).round(2)

station_demand = df.groupby("station_id").agg(
    sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"),
    avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"),
    avg_load=("station_load", "mean"),
    avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"),
    location_type=("location_type", "first"),
).round(2).sort_values("avg_demand", ascending=False)

top10_stations = station_demand.head(10).reset_index()

timeslot_demand = df.groupby("time_slot").agg(
    sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"),
    avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"),
    avg_load=("station_load", "mean"),
    avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"),
).round(2).reindex(["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"])

loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["charging_demand"].mean().unstack().round(2)
loc_timeslot = loc_timeslot[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

# ── Section 2: Queue & Wait Time Analysis ────────────────────────────────────
wait_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["waiting_time"].mean().unstack().round(1)
wait_by_loc_timeslot = wait_by_loc_timeslot[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

queue_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["queue_length"].mean().unstack().round(1)
queue_by_loc_timeslot = queue_by_loc_timeslot[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

wait_by_vehicle = df.groupby("vehicle_type")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1).sort_values(ascending=False)
queue_by_vehicle = df.groupby("vehicle_type")["queue_length"].mean().round(1).sort_values(ascending=False)

wait_by_traffic = df.groupby("traffic_density")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1).reindex(["Low", "Medium", "High"])
queue_by_traffic = df.groupby("traffic_density")["queue_length"].mean().round(1).reindex(["Low", "Medium", "High"])

wait_by_loc = df.groupby("location_type")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1)
wait_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1).reindex(["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"])

# Heatmap data for wait times by location_type x time_slot
wait_heatmap = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["waiting_time"].mean().unstack().round(1)
wait_heatmap = wait_heatmap[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

# Heatmap for queue length
queue_heatmap = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["queue_length"].mean().unstack().round(1)
queue_heatmap = queue_heatmap[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

# Long waits breakdown (>=20 min)
long_waits = df[df["waiting_time"] >= 20]
long_wait_pct = round(len(long_waits) / total_sessions * 100, 1)
long_wait_by_loc = long_waits.groupby("location_type").size()
long_wait_by_timeslot = long_waits.groupby("time_slot").size().reindex(["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"])

# ── Section 3: Energy & Grid Load ────────────────────────────────────────────
load_by_day = df.groupby("day_of_week")["station_load"].mean().round(1)
day_order = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]
load_by_day = load_by_day.reindex(day_order)

load_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["station_load"].mean().round(1).reindex(["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"])

energy_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["energy_consumed_kWh"].mean().unstack().round(1)
energy_by_loc_timeslot = energy_by_loc_timeslot[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

load_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["station_load"].mean().unstack().round(1)
load_by_loc_timeslot = load_by_loc_timeslot[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

power_levels = sorted(df["charging_power_kW"].unique())
power_load = df.groupby("charging_power_kW")["station_load"].mean().round(1).reindex(power_levels)
power_sessions = df.groupby("charging_power_kW").size().reindex(power_levels)

peak_sessions = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"]
offpeak_sessions = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"]
peak_avg_load = round(peak_sessions["station_load"].mean(), 1)
offpeak_avg_load = round(offpeak_sessions["station_load"].mean(), 1)

# ── Section 4: Renewable & Pricing ──────────────────────────────────────────
renewable_by_weather = df.groupby("weather_condition")["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean().round(3).sort_values(ascending=False)
renewable_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean().round(3).reindex(["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"])
renewable_by_loc = df.groupby("location_type")["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean().round(3)

renewable_weather_timeslot = df.groupby(["weather_condition", "time_slot"])["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean().unstack().round(3)
renewable_weather_timeslot = renewable_weather_timeslot[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

price_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["electricity_price"].mean().round(2).reindex(["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"])
price_by_loc = df.groupby("location_type")["electricity_price"].mean().round(2)

price_vs_renewable = df.groupby("time_slot").agg(
    avg_price=("electricity_price", "mean"),
    avg_renewable=("renewable_energy_ratio", "mean"),
    avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"),
    avg_opt_reward=("optimization_reward", "mean"),
).round(3).reindex(["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"])

# Correlation between renewable ratio and electricity price
corr_renewable_price = round(df["renewable_energy_ratio"].corr(df["electricity_price"]), 3)

opt_reward_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["optimization_reward"].mean().round(2).reindex(["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"])

# ── Section 5: Vehicle Charging Behavior ─────────────────────────────────────
vehicle_profiles = df.groupby("vehicle_type").agg(
    sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"),
    avg_battery=("battery_capacity_kWh", "mean"),
    avg_initial_soc=("initial_soc", "mean"),
    avg_final_soc=("final_soc", "mean"),
    avg_energy=("energy_consumed_kWh", "mean"),
    avg_duration=("charging_duration", "mean"),
    avg_power=("charging_power_kW", "mean"),
    avg_wait=("waiting_time", "mean"),
).round(1)

priority_dist = df.groupby(["vehicle_type", "charging_priority"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
priority_pct = (priority_dist.div(priority_dist.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100).round(1)

soc_gain = (df["final_soc"] - df["initial_soc"]).mean().round(1)

# ── Section 6: Optimization Recommendations ─────────────────────────────────
# Load shift opportunity
peak_demand = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"]["charging_demand"].mean()
offpeak_demand = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"]["charging_demand"].mean()
demand_ratio = round(peak_demand / offpeak_demand, 2) if offpeak_demand > 0 else 0

peak_wait = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"]["waiting_time"].mean()
offpeak_wait = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"]["waiting_time"].mean()
wait_diff = round(peak_wait - offpeak_wait, 1)

# Renewable opportunity
clear_renewable = df[df["weather_condition"] == "Clear"]["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean()
snowy_renewable = df[df["weather_condition"] == "Snowy"]["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean() if "Snowy" in df["weather_condition"].values else None

# Price optimization
peak_price = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"]["electricity_price"].mean()
offpeak_price = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"]["electricity_price"].mean()
price_saving_pct = round((peak_price - offpeak_price) / peak_price * 100, 1) if peak_price > 0 else 0

# Highest-load day
highest_load_day = load_by_day.idxmax()
highest_load_val = load_by_day.max()

# Best optimization reward conditions
best_opt = df.groupby(["time_slot", "location_type"])["optimization_reward"].mean().round(2)
worst_opt = best_opt.min()
best_opt_val = best_opt.max()

# ── Helper: DataFrame to chart data ─────────────────────────────────────────
def df_to_chart_labels_values(series_or_df, orient="vertical"):
    """Convert a Series or DataFrame to Chart.js-friendly data."""
    if isinstance(series_or_df, pd.DataFrame):
        return {
            "labels": series_or_df.index.tolist(),
            "datasets": [
                {"label": col, "data": series_or_df[col].tolist()}
                for col in series_or_df.columns
            ]
        }
    else:
        return {
            "labels": series_or_df.index.tolist(),
            "datasets": [{"label": series_or_df.name or "Value", "data": series_or_df.tolist()}]
        }

def series_to_chart(s, label=None):
    return {
        "labels": [str(x) for x in s.index.tolist()],
        "data": [round(x, 2) if isinstance(x, float) else x for x in s.tolist()],
        "label": label or str(s.name)
    }

# ── Build HTML ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

COLORS = {
    "primary": "#2563eb",
    "secondary": "#7c3aed",
    "accent": "#06b6d4",
    "success": "#10b981",
    "warning": "#f59e0b",
    "danger": "#ef4444",
    "peak": "#ef4444",
    "midpeak": "#f59e0b",
    "offpeak": "#10b981",
    "urban": "#2563eb",
    "highway": "#7c3aed",
    "suburban": "#06b6d4",
}

LOC_COLORS = {"Urban": "#2563eb", "Highway": "#7c3aed", "Suburban": "#06b6d4"}
SLOT_COLORS = {"Off-Peak": "#10b981", "Mid-Peak": "#f59e0b", "Peak": "#ef4444"}

def chart_bar(canvas_id, labels, datasets, horizontal=False, stacked=False, y_label="", x_label="", title=""):
    idx_axis = "'y'" if horizontal else "'x'"
    return f"""
    new Chart(document.getElementById('{canvas_id}'), {{
        type: 'bar',
        data: {{
            labels: {json.dumps(labels)},
            datasets: {json.dumps(datasets)}
        }},
        options: {{
            indexAxis: {idx_axis},
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {{ title: {{ display: !!'{title}', text: '{title}' }}, legend: {{ position: 'bottom' }} }},
            scales: {{
                x: {{ stacked: {str(stacked).lower()}, title: {{ display: true, text: '{x_label}' }} }},
                y: {{ stacked: {str(stacked).lower()}, title: {{ display: true, text: '{y_label}' }} }}
            }}
        }}
    }});
    """

def chart_line(canvas_id, labels, datasets, y_label="", x_label="", title=""):
    return f"""
    new Chart(document.getElementById('{canvas_id}'), {{
        type: 'line',
        data: {{
            labels: {json.dumps(labels)},
            datasets: {json.dumps(datasets)}
        }},
        options: {{
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {{ title: {{ display: !!'{title}', text: '{title}' }}, legend: {{ position: 'bottom' }} }},
            scales: {{
                x: {{ title: {{ display: true, text: '{x_label}' }} }},
                y: {{ title: {{ display: true, text: '{y_label}' }} }}
            }}
        }}
    }});
    """

def chart_doughnut(canvas_id, labels, data, colors, title=""):
    return f"""
    new Chart(document.getElementById('{canvas_id}'), {{
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {{
            labels: {json.dumps(labels)},
            datasets: [{{ data: {json.dumps(data)}, backgroundColor: {json.dumps(colors)} }}]
        }},
        options: {{
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {{ title: {{ display: !!'{title}', text: '{title}' }}, legend: {{ position: 'bottom' }} }}
        }}
    }});
    """

def chart_scatter(canvas_id, data_points, x_label, y_label, title=""):
    return f"""
    new Chart(document.getElementById('{canvas_id}'), {{
        type: 'scatter',
        data: {{
            datasets: [{{ label: 'Sessions', data: {json.dumps(data_points)}, backgroundColor: 'rgba(37,99,235,0.3)', borderColor: '#2563eb' }}]
        }},
        options: {{
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {{ title: {{ display: !!'{title}', text: '{title}' }} }},
            scales: {{
                x: {{ title: {{ display: true, text: '{x_label}' }} }},
                y: {{ title: {{ display: true, text: '{y_label}' }} }}
            }}
        }}
    }});
    """

# Build heatmap as inline SVG
def svg_heatmap(data_df, title, color_high="#ef4444", color_low="#dbeafe", cell_w=110, cell_h=50, value_suffix=""):
    rows = data_df.index.tolist()
    cols = data_df.columns.tolist()
    vmin = data_df.min().min()
    vmax = data_df.max().max()

    def lerp_color(val):
        if vmax == vmin:
            t = 0.5
        else:
            t = (val - vmin) / (vmax - vmin)
        # interpolate hex colors
        r_low, g_low, b_low = int(color_low[1:3],16), int(color_low[3:5],16), int(color_low[5:7],16)
        r_high, g_high, b_high = int(color_high[1:3],16), int(color_high[3:5],16), int(color_high[5:7],16)
        r = int(r_low + t * (r_high - r_low))
        g = int(g_low + t * (g_high - g_low))
        b = int(b_low + t * (b_high - b_low))
        return f"rgb({r},{g},{b})"

    margin_left = 80
    margin_top = 40
    total_w = margin_left + len(cols) * cell_w + 10
    total_h = margin_top + len(rows) * cell_h + 40

    svg = f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{total_w}" height="{total_h}" viewBox="0 0 {total_w} {total_h}">'
    svg += f'<text x="{margin_left}" y="20" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">{title}</text>'

    # Column headers
    for j, col in enumerate(cols):
        x = margin_left + j * cell_w + cell_w // 2
        svg += f'<text x="{x}" y="35" font-size="11" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">{col}</text>'

    # Rows
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        y = margin_top + i * cell_h + cell_h // 2
        svg += f'<text x="{margin_left - 8}" y="{y + 4}" font-size="11" fill="#475569" text-anchor="end">{row}</text>'
        for j, col in enumerate(cols):
            val = data_df.loc[row, col]
            color = lerp_color(val)
            rx = margin_left + j * cell_w
            ry = margin_top + i * cell_h
            svg += f'<rect x="{rx}" y="{ry}" width="{cell_w - 2}" height="{cell_h - 2}" rx="4" fill="{color}" />'
            svg += f'<text x="{rx + cell_w // 2}" y="{ry + cell_h // 2 + 4}" font-size="12" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">{val}{value_suffix}</text>'

    svg += '</svg>'
    return svg

# ── Build datasets for charts ────────────────────────────────────────────────

# S1: Demand by location type
s1_demand_by_loc = chart_bar(
    "s1_demand_by_loc",
    loc_demand.index.tolist(),
    [{"label": "Avg Charging Demand", "data": loc_demand["avg_demand"].tolist(), "backgroundColor": [LOC_COLORS.get(l, "#999") for l in loc_demand.index]}],
    y_label="Demand Score"
)

# S1: Demand by time slot
s1_demand_by_ts = chart_bar(

def build_table(headers, rows, id_attr=""):
    html = f'<table id="{id_attr}" class="data-table"><thead><tr>'
    for h in headers:
        html += f'<th>{h}</th>'
    html += '</tr></thead><tbody>'
    for row in rows:
        html += '<tr>'
        for cell in row:
            html += f'<td>{cell}</td>'
        html += '</tr>'
    html += '</tbody></table>'
    return html

307	# Build heatmap as inline SVG
308	def svg_heatmap(data_df, title, color_high="#ef4444", color_low="#dbeafe", cell_w=110, cell_h=50, value_suffix=""):
309	    rows = data_df.index.tolist()
310	    cols = data_df.columns.tolist()
311	    vmin = data_df.min().min()
312	    vmax = data_df.max().max()
313	
314	    def lerp_color(val):
315	        if vmax == vmin:
316	            t = 0.5
317	        else:
318	            t = (val - vmin) / (vmax - vmin)
319	        # interpolate hex colors
320	        r_low, g_low, b_low = int(color_low[1:3],16), int(color_low[3:5],16), int(color_low[5:7],16)
321	        r_high, g_high, b_high = int(color_high[1:3],16), int(color_high[3:5],16), int(color_high[5:7],16)
322	        r = int(r_low + t * (r_high - r_low))
323	        g = int(g_low + t * (g_high - g_low))
324	        b = int(b_low + t * (b_high - b_low))
325	        return f"rgb({r},{g},{b})"
326	
327	    margin_left = 80
328	    margin_top = 40
329	    total_w = margin_left + len(cols) * cell_w + 10
330	    total_h = margin_top + len(rows) * cell_h + 40
331	
332	    svg = f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{total_w}" height="{total_h}" viewBox="0 0 {total_w} {total_h}">'
333	    svg += f'<text x="{margin_left}" y="20" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">{title}</text>'
334	
335	    # Column headers
336	    for j, col in enumerate(cols):
337	        x = margin_left + j * cell_w + cell_w // 2
338	        svg += f'<text x="{x}" y="35" font-size="11" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">{col}</text>'
339	
340	    # Rows
341	    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
342	        y = margin_top + i * cell_h + cell_h // 2
343	        svg += f'<text x="{margin_left - 8}" y="{y + 4}" font-size="11" fill="#475569" text-anchor="end">{row}</text>'
344	        for j, col in enumerate(cols):
345	            val = data_df.loc[row, col]
346	            color = lerp_color(val)
347	            rx = margin_left + j * cell_w
348	            ry = margin_top + i * cell_h
349	            svg += f'<rect x="{rx}" y="{ry}" width="{cell_w - 2}" height="{cell_h - 2}" rx="4" fill="{color}" />'
350	            svg += f'<text x="{rx + cell_w // 2}" y="{ry + cell_h // 2 + 4}" font-size="12" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">{val}{value_suffix}</text>'
351	
352	    svg += '</svg>'
353	    return svg

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate EV Charging Network Performance & Grid Optimization Report."""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df = pd.read_csv("/app/benchmark/data.csv")

# ── Basic cleaning ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df["timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(df["timestamp"], format="mixed", dayfirst=False)
df["waiting_time"] = pd.to_numeric(df["waiting_time"], errors="coerce")
df["energy_consumed_kWh"] = pd.to_numeric(df["energy_consumed_kWh"], errors="coerce")
df["station_load"] = pd.to_numeric(df["station_load"], errors="coerce")
df["renewable_energy_ratio"] = pd.to_numeric(df["renewable_energy_ratio"], errors="coerce")
df["optimization_reward"] = pd.to_numeric(df["optimization_reward"], errors="coerce")
df["electricity_price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["electricity_price"], errors="coerce")
df["charging_duration"] = pd.to_numeric(df["charging_duration"], errors="coerce")
df["charging_power_kW"] = pd.to_numeric(df["charging_power_kW"], errors="coerce")
df["queue_length"] = pd.to_numeric(df["queue_length"], errors="coerce")
df["battery_capacity_kWh"] = pd.to_numeric(df["battery_capacity_kWh"], errors="coerce")
df["initial_soc"] = pd.to_numeric(df["initial_soc"], errors="coerce")
df["final_soc"] = pd.to_numeric(df["final_soc"], errors="coerce")
df["charging_demand"] = pd.to_numeric(df["charging_demand"], errors="coerce")

total_sessions = len(df)

# ── KPIs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
avg_waiting_time = round(df["waiting_time"].mean(), 1)
avg_energy_per_session = round(df["energy_consumed_kWh"].mean(), 1)
mean_station_load = round(df["station_load"].mean(), 1)
mean_renewable_ratio = round(df["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean() * 100, 1)
mean_opt_reward = round(df["optimization_reward"].mean(), 2)

# ── Section 1: Station Utilization & Demand ──────────────────────────────────
loc_demand = df.groupby("location_type").agg(
    sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"),
    avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"),
    avg_energy=("energy_consumed_kWh", "mean"),
    avg_load=("station_load", "mean"),
    avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"),
).round(2)

station_demand = df.groupby("station_id").agg(
    sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"),
    avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"),
    avg_load=("station_load", "mean"),
    avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"),
    location_type=("location_type", "first"),
).round(2).sort_values("avg_demand", ascending=False)

top10_stations = station_demand.head(10).reset_index()

timeslot_demand = df.groupby("time_slot").agg(
    sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"),
    avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"),
    avg_load=("station_load", "mean"),
    avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"),
).round(2).reindex(["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"])

loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["charging_demand"].mean().unstack().round(2)
loc_timeslot = loc_timeslot[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

# ── Section 2: Queue & Wait Time Analysis ────────────────────────────────────
wait_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["waiting_time"].mean().unstack().round(1)
wait_by_loc_timeslot = wait_by_loc_timeslot[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

queue_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["queue_length"].mean().unstack().round(1)
queue_by_loc_timeslot = queue_by_loc_timeslot[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

wait_by_vehicle = df.groupby("vehicle_type")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1).sort_values(ascending=False)
queue_by_vehicle = df.groupby("vehicle_type")["queue_length"].mean().round(1).sort_values(ascending=False)

wait_by_traffic = df.groupby("traffic_density")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1).reindex(["Low", "Medium", "High"])
queue_by_traffic = df.groupby("traffic_density")["queue_length"].mean().round(1).reindex(["Low", "Medium", "High"])

wait_by_loc = df.groupby("location_type")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1)
wait_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1).reindex(["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"])

# Heatmap data for wait times by location_type x time_slot
wait_heatmap = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["waiting_time"].mean().unstack().round(1)
wait_heatmap = wait_heatmap[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

# Heatmap for queue length
queue_heatmap = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["queue_length"].mean().unstack().round(1)
queue_heatmap = queue_heatmap[["Off-Peak", "Mid-Peak", "Peak"]]

# Long waits breakdown (>=20 min)
long_waits = df[df["waiting_time"] >= 20]
long_wait_pct = round(len(long_waits) / total_sessions * 100, 1)

def df_to_chart_labels_values(series_or_df, orient="vertical"):

# Build heatmap as inline SVG
def svg_heatmap(data_df, title, color_high="#ef4444", color_low="#dbeafe", cell_w=110, cell_h=50, value_suffix=""):
    rows = data_df.index.tolist()
    cols = data_df.columns.tolist()
    vmin = data_df.min().min()
    vmax = data_df.max().max()

    def lerp_color(val):
        if vmax == vmin:
            t = 0.5
        else:
            t = (val - vmin) / (vmax - vmin)
        # interpolate hex colors
        r_low, g_low, b_low = int(color_low[1:3],16), int(color_low[3:5],16), int(color_low[5:7],16)
        r_high, g_high, b_high = int(color_high[1:3],16), int(color_high[3:5],16), int(color_high[5:7],16)
        r = int(r_low + t * (r_high - r_low))
        g = int(g_low + t * (g_high - g_low))
        b = int(b_low + t * (b_high - b_low))
        return f"rgb({r},{g},{b})"

    margin_left = 80
    margin_top = 40
    total_w = margin_left + len(cols) * cell_w + 10
    total_h = margin_top + len(rows) * cell_h + 40

    svg = f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{total_w}" height="{total_h}" viewBox="0 0 {total_w} {total_h}">'
    svg += f'<text x="{margin_left}" y="20" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">{title}</text>'

    # Column headers
    for j, col in enumerate(cols):
        x = margin_left + j * cell_w + cell_w // 2
        svg += f'<text x="{x}" y="35" font-size="11" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">{col}</text>'

    # Rows
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        y = margin_top + i * cell_h + cell_h // 2
        svg += f'<text x="{margin_left - 8}" y="{y + 4}" font-size="11" fill="#475569" text-anchor="end">{row}</text>'
        for j, col in enumerate(cols):
            val = data_df.loc[row, col]
            color = lerp_color(val)
            rx = margin_left + j * cell_w
            ry = margin_top + i * cell_h
            svg += f'<rect x="{rx}" y="{ry}" width="{cell_w - 2}" height="{cell_h - 2}" rx="4" fill="{color}" />'
            svg += f'<text x="{rx + cell_w // 2}" y="{ry + cell_h // 2 + 4}" font-size="12" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">{val}{value_suffix}</text>'

    svg += '</svg>'
    return svg

def build_table(headers, rows, id_attr=""):
    html = f'<table id="{id_attr}" class="data-table"><thead><tr>'
    for h in headers:
        html += f'<th>{h}</th>'
    html += '</tr></thead><tbody>'
    for row in rows:
        html += '<tr>'
        for cell in row:
            html += f'<td>{cell}</td>'
        html += '</tr>'
    html += '</tbody></table>'
    return html

<!-- ═══ Section 1: Station Utilization & Demand ═══ -->

307	# Build heatmap as inline SVG
308	def svg_heatmap(data_df, title, color_high="#ef4444", color_low="#dbeafe", cell_w=110, cell_h=50, value_suffix=""):
309	    rows = data_df.index.tolist()
310	    cols = data_df.columns.tolist()
311	    vmin = data_df.min().min()
312	    vmax = data_df.max().max()
313	
314	    def lerp_color(val):
315	        if vmax == vmin:
316	            t = 0.5
317	        else:
318	            t = (val - vmin) / (vmax - vmin)
319	        # interpolate hex colors
320	        r_low, g_low, b_low = int(color_low[1:3],16), int(color_low[3:5],16), int(color_low[5:7],16)
321	        r_high, g_high, b_high = int(color_high[1:3],16), int(color_high[3:5],16), int(color_high[5:7],16)
322	        r = int(r_low + t * (r_high - r_low))
323	        g = int(g_low + t * (g_high - g_low))
324	        b = int(b_low + t * (b_high - b_low))
325	        return f"rgb({r},{g},{b})"
326	
327	    margin_left = 80
328	    margin_top = 40
329	    total_w = margin_left + len(cols) * cell_w + 10
330	    total_h = margin_top + len(rows) * cell_h + 40
331	
332	    svg = f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{total_w}" height="{total_h}" viewBox="0 0 {total_w} {total_h}">'
333	    svg += f'<text x="{margin_left}" y="20" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">{title}</text>'
334	
335	    # Column headers
336	    for j, col in enumerate(cols):
337	        x = margin_left + j * cell_w + cell_w // 2
338	        svg += f'<text x="{x}" y="35" font-size="11" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">{col}</text>'
339	
340	    # Rows
341	    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
342	        y = margin_top + i * cell_h + cell_h // 2
343	        svg += f'<text x="{margin_left - 8}" y="{y + 4}" font-size="11" fill="#475569" text-anchor="end">{row}</text>'
344	        for j, col in enumerate(cols):
345	            val = data_df.loc[row, col]
346	            color = lerp_color(val)
347	            rx = margin_left + j * cell_w
348	            ry = margin_top + i * cell_h
349	            svg += f'<rect x="{rx}" y="{ry}" width="{cell_w - 2}" height="{cell_h - 2}" rx="4" fill="{color}" />'
350	            svg += f'<text x="{rx + cell_w // 2}" y="{ry + cell_h // 2 + 4}" font-size="12" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">{val}{value_suffix}</text>'
351	
352	    svg += '</svg>'
353	    return svg

── Basic cleaning ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── for col in ["waiting_time", "energy_consumed_kWh", "station_load", "renewable_energy_ratio", "optimization_reward", "electricity_price", "charging_duration", "charging_power_kW", "queue_length", "battery_capacity_kWh", "initial_soc", "final_soc", "charging_demand"]: df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce") df["timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(df["timestamp"], format="mixed", dayfirst=False) total_sessions = len(df) # ── Discover actual categories ─────────────────────────────────────────────── time_slots = sorted(df["time_slot"].unique()) # Off-Peak, Peak loc_types = sorted(df["location_type"].unique()) # Highway, Urban vehicle_types = sorted(df["vehicle_type"].unique()) # Bus, Car, Two-Wheeler weather_conditions = sorted(df["weather_condition"].unique()) # Clear, Cloudy, Rainy traffic_densities = ["Low", "Medium", "High"] day_order = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"] # ── KPIs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── avg_waiting_time = round(df["waiting_time"].mean(), 1) avg_energy_per_session = round(df["energy_consumed_kWh"].mean(), 1) mean_station_load = round(df["station_load"].mean(), 1) mean_renewable_ratio = round(df["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean() * 100, 1) mean_opt_reward = round(df["optimization_reward"].mean(), 2) # ── Section 1: Station Utilization & Demand ────────────────────────────────── loc_demand = df.groupby("location_type").agg( sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"), avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"), avg_energy=("energy_consumed_kWh", "mean"), avg_load=("station_load", "mean"), avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"), ).round(2) station_demand = df.groupby("station_id").agg( sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"), avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"), avg_load=("station_load", "mean"), avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"), location_type=("location_type", "first"), ).round(2).sort_values("avg_demand", ascending=False) top10_stations = station_demand.head(10).reset_index() timeslot_demand = df.groupby("time_slot").agg( sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"), avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"), avg_load=("station_load", "mean"), avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"), ).round(2).reindex(time_slots) loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["charging_demand"].mean().unstack().round(2) loc_timeslot = loc_timeslot.reindex(columns=time_slots) # ── Section 2: Queue & Wait Time Analysis ──────────────────────────────────── wait_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["waiting_time"].mean().unstack().round(1) wait_by_loc_timeslot = wait_by_loc_timeslot.reindex(columns=time_slots) queue_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["queue_length"].mean().unstack().round(1) queue_by_loc_timeslot = queue_by_loc_timeslot.reindex(columns=time_slots) wait_by_vehicle = df.groupby("vehicle_type")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1).sort_values(ascending=False) queue_by_vehicle = df.groupby("vehicle_type")["queue_length"].mean().round(1).sort_values(ascending=False) wait_by_traffic = df.groupby("traffic_density")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1) wait_by_traffic = wait_by_traffic.reindex([t for t in traffic_densities if t in wait_by_traffic.index]) queue_by_traffic = df.groupby("traffic_density")["queue_length"].mean().round(1) queue_by_traffic = queue_by_traffic.reindex([t for t in traffic_densities if t in queue_by_traffic.index]) wait_by_loc = df.groupby("location_type")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1) wait_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1).reindex(time_slots) wait_heatmap = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["waiting_time"].mean().unstack().round(1) wait_heatmap = wait_heatmap.reindex(columns=time_slots) queue_heatmap = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["queue_length"].mean().unstack().round(1) queue_heatmap = queue_heatmap.reindex(columns=time_slots) long_waits = df[df["waiting_time"] >= 20] long_wait_pct = round(len(long_waits) / total_sessions * 100, 1) long_wait_by_loc = long_waits.groupby("location_type").size() long_wait_by_timeslot = long_waits.groupby("time_slot").size().reindex(time_slots).fillna(0).astype(int) # ── Section 3: Energy & Grid Load ──────────────────────────────────────────── load_by_day = df.groupby("day_of_week")["station_load"].mean().round(1).reindex(day_order) load_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["station_load"].mean().round(1).reindex(time_slots) load_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["station_load"].mean().unstack().round(1) load_by_loc_timeslot = load_by_loc_timeslot.reindex(columns=time_slots) power_levels = sorted(df["charging_power_kW"].dropna().unique()) power_load = df.groupby("charging_power_kW")["station_load"].mean().round(1).reindex(power_levels) peak_sessions = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"] offpeak_sessions = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"] peak_avg_load = round(peak_sessions["station_load"].mean(), 1) offpeak_avg_load = round(offpeak_sessions["station_load"].mean(), 1) # ── Section 5: Vehicle Charging Behavior ───────────────────────────────────── vehicle_profiles = df.groupby("vehicle_type").agg( sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"), avg_battery=("battery_capacity_kWh", "mean"), avg_initial_soc=("initial_soc", "mean"), avg_final_soc=("final_soc", "mean"), avg_energy=("energy_consumed_kWh", "mean"), avg_duration=("charging_duration", "mean"), avg_power=("charging_power_kW", "mean"), avg_wait=("waiting_time", "mean"), ).round(1) priority_dist = df.groupby(["vehicle_type", "charging_priority"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0) priority_pct = (priority_dist.div(priority_dist.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100).round(1) soc_gain = (df["final_soc"] - df["initial_soc"]).mean().round(1) # ── Section 6: Optimization Recommendations ───────────────────────────────── peak_demand = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"]["charging_demand"].mean() offpeak_demand = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"]["charging_demand"].mean() demand_ratio = round(peak_demand / offpeak_demand, 2) if offpeak_demand > 0 else 0 peak_wait = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"]["waiting_time"].mean() offpeak_wait = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"]["waiting_time"].mean() wait_diff = round(peak_wait - offpeak_wait, 1) peak_price = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"]["electricity_price"].mean() offpeak_price = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"]["electricity_price"].mean() price_saving_pct = round((peak_price - offpeak_price) / peak_price * 100, 1) if peak_price > 0 else 0 highest_load_day = load_by_day.idxmax() highest_load_val = load_by_day.max() best_opt = df.groupby(["time_slot", "location_type"])["optimization_reward"].mean().round(2) # ── Chart helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── def chart_bar(canvas_id, labels, datasets, horizontal=False, stacked=False, y_label="", x_label="", title=""): idx_axis = "'y'" if horizontal else "'x'" return f""" new Chart(document.getElementById('{canvas_id}'), {{ type: 'bar', data: {{ labels: {json.dumps([str(l) for l in labels])}, datasets: {json.dumps(datasets)} }}, options: {{ indexAxis: {idx_axis}, responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: {{ title: {{ display: false }}, legend: {{ position: 'bottom' }} }}, scales: {{ x: {{ stacked: {str(stacked).lower()}, title: {{ display: true, text: '{x_label}' }} }}, y: {{ stacked: {str(stacked).lower()}, title: {{ display: true, text: '{y_label}' }} }} }} }} }}); """ def chart_doughnut(canvas_id, labels, data, colors, title=""): return f""" new Chart(document.getElementById('{canvas_id}'), {{ type: 'doughnut', data: {{ labels: {json.dumps([str(l) for l in labels])}, datasets: [{{ data: {json.dumps(data)}, backgroundColor: {json.dumps(colors)} }}] }}, options: {{ responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: {{ title: {{ display: false }}, legend: {{ position: 'bottom' }} }} }} }}); """ # Build heatmap as inline SVG def svg_heatmap(data_df, title, color_high="#ef4444", color_low="#dbeafe", cell_w=130, cell_h=50, value_suffix=""): rows = data_df.index.tolist() cols = data_df.columns.tolist() vmin = data_df.min().min() vmax = data_df.max().max() def lerp_color(val): t = 0.5 if vmax == vmin else (val - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) r_low, g_low, b_low = int(color_low[1:3],16), int(color_low[3:5],16), int(color_low[5:7],16) r_high, g_high, b_high = int(color_high[1:3],16), int(color_high[3:5],16), int(color_high[5:7],16) r = int(r_low + t * (r_high - r_low)) g = int(g_low + t * (g_high - g_low)) b = int(b_low + t * (b_high - b_low)) return f"rgb({r},{g},{b})" margin_left = 80 margin_top = 40 total_w = margin_left + len(cols) * cell_w + 10 total_h = margin_top + len(rows) * cell_h + 40 svg = f'' return svg def build_table(headers, rows, id_attr=""): html = f'' for h in headers: html += f'' html += '' for row in rows: html += '' for cell in row: html += f'' html += '' html += '

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """Generate EV Charging Network Performance & Grid Optimization Report.""" import pandas as pd import numpy as np import json import os # ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── df = pd.read_csv("/app/benchmark/data.csv") # ── Basic cleaning ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── for col in ["waiting_time", "energy_consumed_kWh", "station_load", "renewable_energy_ratio", "optimization_reward", "electricity_price", "charging_duration", "charging_power_kW", "queue_length", "battery_capacity_kWh", "initial_soc", "final_soc", "charging_demand"]: df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce") df["timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(df["timestamp"], format="mixed", dayfirst=False) total_sessions = len(df) # ── Discover actual categories ─────────────────────────────────────────────── time_slots = sorted(df["time_slot"].unique()) # Off-Peak, Peak loc_types = sorted(df["location_type"].unique()) # Highway, Urban vehicle_types = sorted(df["vehicle_type"].unique()) # Bus, Car, Two-Wheeler weather_conditions = sorted(df["weather_condition"].unique()) # Clear, Cloudy, Rainy traffic_densities = ["Low", "Medium", "High"] day_order = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"] # ── KPIs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── avg_waiting_time = round(df["waiting_time"].mean(), 1) avg_energy_per_session = round(df["energy_consumed_kWh"].mean(), 1) mean_station_load = round(df["station_load"].mean(), 1) mean_renewable_ratio = round(df["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean() * 100, 1) mean_opt_reward = round(df["optimization_reward"].mean(), 2) # ── Section 1: Station Utilization & Demand ────────────────────────────────── loc_demand = df.groupby("location_type").agg( sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"), avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"), avg_energy=("energy_consumed_kWh", "mean"), avg_load=("station_load", "mean"), avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"), ).round(2) station_demand = df.groupby("station_id").agg( sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"), avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"), avg_load=("station_load", "mean"), avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"), location_type=("location_type", "first"), ).round(2).sort_values("avg_demand", ascending=False) top10_stations = station_demand.head(10).reset_index() timeslot_demand = df.groupby("time_slot").agg( sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"), avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"), avg_load=("station_load", "mean"), avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"), ).round(2).reindex(time_slots) loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["charging_demand"].mean().unstack().round(2) loc_timeslot = loc_timeslot.reindex(columns=time_slots) # ── Section 2: Queue & Wait Time Analysis ──────────────────────────────────── wait_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["waiting_time"].mean().unstack().round(1) wait_by_loc_timeslot = wait_by_loc_timeslot.reindex(columns=time_slots) queue_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["queue_length"].mean().unstack().round(1) queue_by_loc_timeslot = queue_by_loc_timeslot.reindex(columns=time_slots) wait_by_vehicle = df.groupby("vehicle_type")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1).sort_values(ascending=False) queue_by_vehicle = df.groupby("vehicle_type")["queue_length"].mean().round(1).sort_values(ascending=False) wait_by_traffic = df.groupby("traffic_density")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1) wait_by_traffic = wait_by_traffic.reindex([t for t in traffic_densities if t in wait_by_traffic.index]) queue_by_traffic = df.groupby("traffic_density")["queue_length"].mean().round(1) queue_by_traffic = queue_by_traffic.reindex([t for t in traffic_densities if t in queue_by_traffic.index]) wait_by_loc = df.groupby("location_type")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1) wait_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["waiting_time"].mean().round(1).reindex(time_slots) wait_heatmap = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["waiting_time"].mean().unstack().round(1) wait_heatmap = wait_heatmap.reindex(columns=time_slots) queue_heatmap = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["queue_length"].mean().unstack().round(1) queue_heatmap = queue_heatmap.reindex(columns=time_slots) long_waits = df[df["waiting_time"] >= 20] long_wait_pct = round(len(long_waits) / total_sessions * 100, 1) long_wait_by_loc = long_waits.groupby("location_type").size() long_wait_by_timeslot = long_waits.groupby("time_slot").size().reindex(time_slots).fillna(0).astype(int) # ── Section 3: Energy & Grid Load ──────────────────────────────────────────── load_by_day = df.groupby("day_of_week")["station_load"].mean().round(1).reindex(day_order) load_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["station_load"].mean().round(1).reindex(time_slots) load_by_loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["station_load"].mean().unstack().round(1) load_by_loc_timeslot = load_by_loc_timeslot.reindex(columns=time_slots) power_levels = sorted(df["charging_power_kW"].dropna().unique()) power_load = df.groupby("charging_power_kW")["station_load"].mean().round(1).reindex(power_levels) peak_sessions = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"] offpeak_sessions = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"] peak_avg_load = round(peak_sessions["station_load"].mean(), 1) offpeak_avg_load = round(offpeak_sessions["station_load"].mean(), 1) # ── Section 4: Renewable & Pricing ────────────────────────────────────────── renewable_by_weather = df.groupby("weather_condition")["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean().round(3).sort_values(ascending=False) renewable_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean().round(3).reindex(time_slots) renewable_by_loc = df.groupby("location_type")["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean().round(3) renewable_weather_timeslot = df.groupby(["weather_condition", "time_slot"])["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean().unstack().round(3) renewable_weather_timeslot = renewable_weather_timeslot.reindex(columns=time_slots) price_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["electricity_price"].mean().round(2).reindex(time_slots) price_by_loc = df.groupby("location_type")["electricity_price"].mean().round(2) price_vs_renewable = df.groupby("time_slot").agg( avg_price=("electricity_price", "mean"), avg_renewable=("renewable_energy_ratio", "mean"), avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"), avg_opt_reward=("optimization_reward", "mean"), ).round(3).reindex(time_slots) corr_renewable_price = round(df["renewable_energy_ratio"].corr(df["electricity_price"]), 3) opt_reward_by_timeslot = df.groupby("time_slot")["optimization_reward"].mean().round(2).reindex(time_slots) # ── Section 5: Vehicle Charging Behavior ───────────────────────────────────── vehicle_profiles = df.groupby("vehicle_type").agg( sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"), avg_battery=("battery_capacity_kWh", "mean"), avg_initial_soc=("initial_soc", "mean"), avg_final_soc=("final_soc", "mean"), avg_energy=("energy_consumed_kWh", "mean"), avg_duration=("charging_duration", "mean"), avg_power=("charging_power_kW", "mean"), avg_wait=("waiting_time", "mean"), ).round(1) priority_dist = df.groupby(["vehicle_type", "charging_priority"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0) priority_pct = (priority_dist.div(priority_dist.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100).round(1) soc_gain = (df["final_soc"] - df["initial_soc"]).mean().round(1) # ── Section 6: Optimization Recommendations ───────────────────────────────── peak_demand = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"]["charging_demand"].mean() offpeak_demand = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"]["charging_demand"].mean() demand_ratio = round(peak_demand / offpeak_demand, 2) if offpeak_demand > 0 else 0 peak_wait = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"]["waiting_time"].mean() offpeak_wait = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"]["waiting_time"].mean() wait_diff = round(peak_wait - offpeak_wait, 1) peak_price = df[df["time_slot"] == "Peak"]["electricity_price"].mean() offpeak_price = df[df["time_slot"] == "Off-Peak"]["electricity_price"].mean() price_saving_pct = round((peak_price - offpeak_price) / peak_price * 100, 1) if peak_price > 0 else 0 highest_load_day = load_by_day.idxmax() highest_load_val = load_by_day.max() best_opt = df.groupby(["time_slot", "location_type"])["optimization_reward"].mean().round(2) # Urban peak wait urban_peak_wait = wait_by_loc_timeslot.loc["Urban", "Peak"] if "Urban" in wait_by_loc_timeslot.index else "N/A" # ── Color maps ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── LOC_COLORS = {"Urban": "#2563eb", "Highway": "#7c3aed", "Suburban": "#06b6d4"} SLOT_COLORS = {"Off-Peak": "#10b981", "Peak": "#ef4444"} def loc_color(l): return LOC_COLORS.get(l, "#64748b") def slot_color(s): return SLOT_COLORS.get(s, "#64748b") # ── Chart helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── def chart_bar(canvas_id, labels, datasets, horizontal=False, stacked=False, y_label="", x_label="", title=""): idx_axis = "'y'" if horizontal else "'x'" return f""" new Chart(document.getElementById('{canvas_id}'), {{ type: 'bar', data: {{ labels: {json.dumps([str(l) for l in labels])}, datasets: {json.dumps(datasets)} }}, options: {{ indexAxis: {idx_axis}, responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: {{ title: {{ display: false }}, legend: {{ position: 'bottom' }} }}, scales: {{ x: {{ stacked: {str(stacked).lower()}, title: {{ display: true, text: '{x_label}' }} }}, y: {{ stacked: {str(stacked).lower()}, title: {{ display: true, text: '{y_label}' }} }} }} }} }}); """ def chart_doughnut(canvas_id, labels, data, colors, title=""): return f""" new Chart(document.getElementById('{canvas_id}'), {{ type: 'doughnut', data: {{ labels: {json.dumps([str(l) for l in labels])}, datasets: [{{ data: {json.dumps(data)}, backgroundColor: {json.dumps(colors)} }}] }}, options: {{ responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: {{ title: {{ display: false }}, legend: {{ position: 'bottom' }} }} }} }}); """ # Build heatmap as inline SVG def svg_heatmap(data_df, title, color_high="#ef4444", color_low="#dbeafe", cell_w=130, cell_h=50, value_suffix=""): rows = data_df.index.tolist() cols = data_df.columns.tolist() vmin = data_df.min().min() vmax = data_df.max().max() def lerp_color(val): t = 0.5 if vmax == vmin else (val - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) r_low, g_low, b_low = int(color_low[1:3],16), int(color_low[3:5],16), int(color_low[5:7],16) r_high, g_high, b_high = int(color_high[1:3],16), int(color_high[3:5],16), int(color_high[5:7],16) r = int(r_low + t * (r_high - r_low)) g = int(g_low + t * (g_high - g_low)) b = int(b_low + t * (b_high - b_low)) return f"rgb({r},{g},{b})" margin_left = 80 margin_top = 40 total_w = margin_left + len(cols) * cell_w + 10 total_h = margin_top + len(rows) * cell_h + 40 svg = f'' return svg def build_table(headers, rows, id_attr=""): html = f'' for h in headers: html += f'' html += '' for row in rows: html += '' for cell in row: html += f'' html += '' html += '

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """Generate EV Charging Network Performance & Grid Optimization Report.""" import pandas as pd import numpy as np import json import os # ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── df = pd.read_csv("/app/benchmark/data.csv") # ── Basic cleaning ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── for col in ["waiting_time", "energy_consumed_kWh", "station_load", "renewable_energy_ratio", "optimization_reward", "electricity_price", "charging_duration", "charging_power_kW", "queue_length", "battery_capacity_kWh", "initial_soc", "final_soc", "charging_demand"]: df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce") df["timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(df["timestamp"], format="mixed", dayfirst=False) total_sessions = len(df) # ── Discover actual categories ─────────────────────────────────────────────── time_slots = sorted(df["time_slot"].unique()) # Off-Peak, Peak loc_types = sorted(df["location_type"].unique()) # Highway, Urban vehicle_types = sorted(df["vehicle_type"].unique()) # Bus, Car, Two-Wheeler weather_conditions = sorted(df["weather_condition"].unique()) # Clear, Cloudy, Rainy traffic_densities = ["Low", "Medium", "High"] day_order = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"] # ── KPIs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── avg_waiting_time = round(df["waiting_time"].mean(), 1) avg_energy_per_session = round(df["energy_consumed_kWh"].mean(), 1) mean_station_load = round(df["station_load"].mean(), 1) mean_renewable_ratio = round(df["renewable_energy_ratio"].mean() * 100, 1) mean_opt_reward = round(df["optimization_reward"].mean(), 2) # ── Section 1: Station Utilization & Demand ────────────────────────────────── loc_demand = df.groupby("location_type").agg( sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"), avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"), avg_energy=("energy_consumed_kWh", "mean"), avg_load=("station_load", "mean"), avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"), ).round(2) station_demand = df.groupby("station_id").agg( sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"), avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"), avg_load=("station_load", "mean"), avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"), location_type=("location_type", "first"), ).round(2).sort_values("avg_demand", ascending=False) top10_stations = station_demand.head(10).reset_index() timeslot_demand = df.groupby("time_slot").agg( sessions=("energy_consumed_kWh", "count"), avg_demand=("charging_demand", "mean"), avg_load=("station_load", "mean"), avg_queue=("queue_length", "mean"), ).round(2).reindex(time_slots) loc_timeslot = df.groupby(["location_type", "time_slot"])["charging_demand"].mean().unstack().round(2) loc_timeslot = loc_timeslot.reindex(columns=time_slots) # #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Generate EV Charging Network Performance & Grid Optimization Report.""" import pandas as pd import numpy as np import json import os # ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── df = pd.read_csv("/app/benchmark/data.csv") # ── Basic cleaning ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── for col in ["waiting_time", "energy_consumed_kWh", "station_load", "renewable_energy_ratio", "optimization_reward", "electricity_price", "charging_duration", "charging_power_kW", "queue_length", "battery_capacity_kWh", "initial_soc", "final_soc", "charging_demand"]: df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce") df["timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(df["timestamp"], format="mixed", dayfirst=False) total_sessions = len(df) # ── Discover actual categories ─────────────────────────────────────────────── time_slots = sorted(df["time_slot"].unique()) # Off-Peak, Peak loc_types = sorted(df["location_type"].unique()) # Highway, Urban vehicle_types = sorted(df["vehicle_type"].unique()) # Bus, Car, Two-Wheeler weather_conditions = sorted(df["weather_condition"].unique()) # Clear, Cloudy, Rainy traffic_densities = ["Low", "Medium", "High"] day_order = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"] # The report has been generated at `/app/output/final_report.html` (43KB, 760 lines). 

**Summary of what was produced:**

A self-contained HTML report with a dashboard-style layout covering all 6 required sections:

1. **Station Utilization & Demand** — Demand by location type (Urban/Highway), time slot (Off-Peak/Peak), heatmap of location x time slot demand, top 10 stations by demand
2. **Queue & Wait Time Analysis** — Heatmaps of wait times and queue lengths by location type x time slot, breakdowns by vehicle type and traffic density, customer experience alert for 20+ min waits
3. **Energy & Grid Load Patterns** — Station load by day of week and time slot, load heatmap, power level vs. load analysis, Peak vs Off-Peak load comparison
4. **Renewable Energy Integration & Dynamic Pricing** — Renewable ratio by weather condition and time slot, heatmap of weather x time slot, price vs. renewable correlation, optimization reward by time slot
5. **Vehicle Charging Behavior** — Vehicle profiles table, energy/duration charts, priority distribution, session composition summary
6. **Optimization Recommendations** — 6 actionable recommendations covering peak load shifting, green charging windows, urban capacity expansion, highway load balancing, weather-responsive pricing, and fleet priority optimization

All KPIs are derived from the actual data: Avg Wait 9.5 min, Avg Energy 39.1 kWh, Mean Load 53.2 kW, Renewable Ratio 35.4%, Mean Opt. Reward -11.83. Visualizations use Chart.js (CDN) and inline SVG heatmaps.
